## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for users or contributors. Link a
related issue when applicable.

## Validation

List commands run and their results. Explain any checks that could not run.
Include screenshots for visible UI changes when useful.

## Risks and follow-up

Note configuration, compatibility, data-safety, or dependency implications.
Write "None" if there are no material risks or follow-up items.

## Checklist

- [ ] Repository content and contribution text are in English.
- [ ] The change is focused and related documentation is updated.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass (`make check`; build/smoke for integration changes).
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or real database dumps are included.
